title: Man. Post. Cap. VIII: false unjust imputation; tip before Gospel-promise argument
pass_a_gloss: Consider, please, what false and unjust imputation would be, if this is not; and whether an action befits God that makes us sinners who otherwise were not—and formally and of itself—and whether that is not to refer the cause of all our sins and evils to God; give glory to your creator and redeemer. Recall what Placeus said in Cap. 3 of this examination § III. Do not think your view is drawn from the ancient fathers or from those who first chiefly set hand to reforming the Church in the last century. They thought far otherwise, as God willing he will make plain in another chapter. For now it is enough to untie your arguments' knots. Tip before the Gospel-promise / seed-of-the-woman argument.
pass_b_english: Consider, I beg you, what a false and unjust imputation would be, if this is not; And whether an action befits God which makes us sinners who otherwise were not sinners, and indeed formally, and of itself, and whether this is not to refer the cause of all our sins and evils to God; and give glory to your creator and redeemer. Call back to mind what I said in Cap. 3 of this examination § III. And do not think that opinion of yours was drawn and deduced from the fountains either of the ancient fathers, or of those who first and chiefly set hand to reforming the Church in the last century. Far otherwise did they think, as, God granting, I shall make plain in another Chapter. For now it is enough for me to untie the knots of your arguments.
source_text: Considera, quaeso, quae sit falsa & injusta imputatio, si haec non est; Et, an conveniat Deo actio, quae nos alioqui non peccatores, peccatores faciat, & quidem formaliter, & per se, & annon hoc sit causam omnium nostrorum peccatorum & malorum in Deum referre; & da gloriam creatori tuo & redemptori. Revoca in animum quae dixi Cap. 3. hujus examinis §. III. Neque puta tuam illam sententiam esse ex fontibus vel patrum antiquorum, vel eorum qui primi & praecipue manum admoverunt Ecclesiae Reformandae seculo superiore, haustam & deductam. Longe aliter illi senserunt, ut, Deo dante, faciam alio Capite manifestum. Nunc mihi satis est tuorum argumentorum nodos solvere.
